name: Wanting To Be Married
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is God's design to provide companionship and unity, as seen when God declared it was not good for man to be alone and created a suitable helper for him. The union of husband and wife is intended to be a lifelong bond, symbolized by becoming one flesh. Finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing and favor from the Lord, with a virtuous and prudent wife being a valuable inheritance. Jesus affirmed this divine design by referencing the creation of male and female at the beginning, underscoring marriage as part of God's original plan.
